articles.title: Keralam seeks Centre's help as oil firms refuse ethanol-free petrol samples
articles.description: Keralam's government has asked for the Centre's help in acquiring necessary ethanol-free petrol samples. State officials are concerned about ethanol's impact on automobile engines amid rising complaints. The request follows failed attempts to obtain necessary samples from oil companies for verification. Inspections were initiated after allegations of excess ethanol content in petrol surfaced in Karnataka. The state aims to ensure compliance with permissible ethanol limits in petrol distribution.
